derivation: from a compound of G3844 (παρά) and G236 (ἀλλάσσω);
def: transmutation (of phase or orbit), i.e. (figuratively) fickleness

occurrences.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
